# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This file provides custom instructions for GitHub Copilot when working in this repository.

## Repository Overview

This is a skills repository for learning GitHub Copilot with Codespaces and VS Code.

## Coding Standards

- Follow clean code principles
- Write clear, descriptive commit messages
- Keep functions small and focused
- Use meaningful variable and function names

## Best Practices

- Test your changes before committing
- Write self-documenting code
- Add comments only when necessary to explain "why", not "what"
- Keep dependencies up to date

## Code Review Guidelines

- Ensure all tests pass before submitting pull requests
- Review your own code first before requesting review from others
- Address all feedback constructively

## Documentation

- Update README.md when adding new features
- Document any setup or configuration requirements
- Keep documentation in sync with code changes
